Choose the room, choose the fabric

We start with how you use the room, when the sunlight is strongest and how much of the view you want to keep. A fabric that works well in the living room may let in too much light for a bedroom. Seeing the options together helps make those differences clear.

Roller shades, screen shades and honeycomb shades are a large part of our work. We've used solar mesh shades in Valley storefronts to help manage glare while keeping a view outside. At home, the same questions about light, privacy and everyday use help narrow the choices.

We also carry Alta shades if you'd like to compare another option for your project.

Hunter Douglas shade collections

As a Hunter Douglas dealer, we can help you compare the collections by fabric, construction and control options.

Roller and solar shadesCellular and honeycomb shadesSheer shadesRoman shadesWoven wood shadesVertical shades and panels

Roller and solar shades

Designer Roller Shades use a single fabric panel that rolls up at the top of the window. Designer Screen Shades help manage sun and glare while preserving a view out. Designer Banded Shades alternate sheer and solid bands. Alustra® Woven Textures® Roller Shades and Alustra® Architectural Roller Shades offer additional fabric textures and constructions to compare.

Cellular and honeycomb shades

Duette® Honeycomb Shades and Applause® Cellular Shades use cellular fabrics that add insulation at the window. Sonnette® Cellular Roller Shades combine cellular construction with a roller-style design. Each has its own fabric and operating choices to consider.

Sheer shades

Silhouette® Sheer Shades, Pirouette® Sheer Shades and Nantucket™ Sheer Shades use adjustable fabric vanes to change the light and view. Their fabrics and construction differ, so it helps to see how each one looks open and closed.

Roman shades

Vignette® Modern Roman Shades, Carole Fabrics® Roman Shades and Alustra® Woven Textures® Roman Shades give you a fabric treatment with folds. Compare the fold styles, fabrics and lining options, including how much of the window each treatment covers when raised.

Woven wood shades

Provenance® Woven Wood Shades bring natural woven materials to the window. The weave and lining affect how much you can see through, so we'll discuss privacy as well as texture. Alustra® Woven Textures® collections provide other woven-fabric choices in roller and Roman styles.

Vertical shades and panels

For wide windows and sliding doors, compare Luminette® Sheer Panels and Skyline® Gliding Window Panels. The opening direction, space for the panels to stack and clearance around door handles all matter.

Daytime glare and nighttime privacy

A screen fabric can preserve your view during the day, but a lit room may be visible from outside after dark. If you need nighttime privacy, tell us before you settle on a fabric. We can discuss an additional privacy layer or a different shade configuration.

For a bedroom, we'll also look at room-darkening fabrics and the light that can enter around the edges. The fabric and the way the shade fits both matter.

Measuring, installation and help afterward

Once you've chosen a shade, we take the measurements, check the mounting space and confirm the controls before ordering. At installation, we check operation and show you how to use the shades.

If a backorder changes the schedule, we'll keep you informed. If a question comes up after installation, you can contact us for help.

Questions about custom shades

Ask John and Max: (818) 884-5464
Can I motorize the shades I choose?

Many collections offer motorized options. We'll confirm what's available for the specific product, window size and controls you want before you order.

Can I coordinate shades in different rooms?

Yes. We can compare fabrics and colors across the rooms you're working on. That may mean using different shade types where the light, privacy or door access calls for it.

What affects the price?

Window size, fabric, product construction and controls all affect the cost. After discussing your budget and choices, we take professional measurements and prepare a quote.
